C1764.title: APK Repackaging Detection: Ad SDK Injection and Data Collection Module Implantation
C1764.summary: Attackers repackage apps by injecting ad network SDK code into Activities or Services, causing pop-up ads or persistent background displays. They also implant data collection modules to harvest device IMEI, MAC address, location coordinates, and contact lists, periodically uploading the information to remote servers.
